name: Yomi Kaki
source:
"The scariest thing is forgetting."

The school newspaper club wrapped up their investigation on the invisible man.
And meeting this unknown entity shattered their familiar reality.
But what’s even scarier is that their daily life was already disrupted before that.
The city, the school, the newspaper club—something’s wrong with everything.
The people around them know but are too afraid to speak up.
The protagonist, completely unaware of why and how, must dig up the truth everyone’s scared to talk about and uncover the hidden mystery.
Your choices will change how the club members feel about you.
And if they open their hearts to you, it’ll definitely help you solve the mysteries of this world.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1829496]booth[/url]]
translation:
“最可怕的是忘记。”

校报社结束了对隐形人的调查。
遇见这个未知的实体打破了他们熟悉的现实。
但更可怕的是，他们的日常生活在此之前就已经被打乱了。
城市、学校、报社——一切都出了问题。
周围的人都知道，但都不敢说出来。
主角在完全不知道为什么以及如何的情况下，必须挖掘出每个人都不敢谈论的真相并揭开隐藏的谜团。
你的选择将改变俱乐部成员对你的看法。
如果他们向你敞开心扉，那肯定会帮助你解开这个世界的谜团。

[翻译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1829496]booth[/url]]
